Name: The Bridunow Brothers
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]With permission from Bridunow, I've revived their old NPCs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13637]Daniel[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13402]Chase[/url] for Stardew 1.6![/size]

[size=4]Chase and Daniel are a pair of bachelors living in a house up on Downhill. Daniel runs a climbing school, accessable near Robin's, while Chase is disabled and studying hard to be a lawyer. Both are dateable and have full heart events and schedules.[/size]

[size=4]NOTE: if adding this mod mid-save you will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44842?tab=posts]Reset Terrain Features[/url] to remove the trees and bushes from where their house is.[/size]

[size=4]As of 1.0.5 there are new alternate portraits by Wizadroid. If you prefer the originals just toggle them off in the config[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]

[size=4]
~Like my work? [url=https://ko-fi.com/silvermoonchan]Buy me a coffee![/url] ☕ [/size]
